## 当前接口RunHotTopicChat说明

欢迎前往[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)体验。

**通过SDK方式调用API，请可参考[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)“API”页签下的java、python示例！**

**通过SDK方式调用API，请可参考[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)“API”页签下的java、python示例！**

**通过SDK方式调用API，请可参考[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)“API”页签下的java、python示例！**

## 新闻热榜互动全量API说明
### API明细

#### AI妙笔SDK下：对应alibabacloud-aimiaobi20230801

- [**GetHotTopicBroadcast**](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-gethottopicbroadcast?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-2400256.d_0) - **查询完整播报单（热榜）** --常用
- [SubmitCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-submitcustomhottopicbroadcastjob?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_3_2_0_3_11_1.6e8226ccRBFaYz) - 提交自定义播报单任务
- [GetCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-getcustomhottopicbroadcastjob?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_3_2_0_3_11_0.fd006c4cdnYwwj) - 获取自定义播报单任务结果

#### 阿里云百炼全妙轻应用SDK下：对应alibabacloud-quanmiaolightapp20240801

- **RunHotTopicChat** - **播报单（热榜）问答** --常用
- [RunHotTopicSummary](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-runhottopicsummary?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_4_3_1_3_4_1.420a7c48CBWA8o) - 播报单热点自定义摘要生成

### 场景说明
#### 场景1：获取完整播报单（热榜）全量或者部分频道热点：
- GetHotTopicBroadcast：查询播报单

#### 场景2：针对播报单或通用领域问题做问答：
- RunHotTopicChat：问答

#### 场景3：内置播报单（热榜）不满足要求，需要个性化定制（频道、个性化摘要等）：
- SubmitCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob：提交自定义播报单任务
- GetCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob：轮训自定义播报单任务状态
- GetHotTopicBroadcast：获取自定义播报单信息

## About the RunHotTopicChat API

Use this API to ask questions about broadcast lists (hot topics), hot topic news, and open-domain content. It supports channel recommendations, hot topic recommendations, and hot topic content Q\&A.

Try it in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).

**To call this API using an SDK, see the Java and Python examples on the API tab in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).**

**To call this API with an SDK, see the Java and Python examples on the API tab in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).**

**To call this API using an SDK, see the Java and Python examples on the API tab in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).**

## Full API reference for news hot topic interaction

### API list

#### In the AI Miaobi SDK: alibabacloud-aimiaobi20230801

- [**GetHotTopicBroadcast**](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-gethottopicbroadcast?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-2400256.d_0) — **Retrieve a full broadcast list (hot topics)** — Commonly used

- [SubmitCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-submitcustomhottopicbroadcastjob?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_3_2_0_3_11_1.6e8226ccRBFaYz) — Submit a custom broadcast list job

- [GetCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-getcustomhottopicbroadcastjob?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_3_2_0_3_11_0.fd006c4cdnYwwj) — Retrieve the result of a custom broadcast list job

#### In the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Quanmiao Lightweight Application SDK: alibabacloud-quanmiaolightapp20240801

- **RunHotTopicChat** — **Q\&A for broadcast lists (hot topics)** — Commonly used

- [RunHotTopicSummary](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-runhottopicsummary?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_3_4_3_1_3_4_1.420a7c48CBWA8o) — Generate a custom summary for a broadcast list hot topic

### Use cases

#### Use case 1: Retrieve all or selected channel hot topics from a full broadcast list (hot topics)

- GetHotTopicBroadcast — Retrieve a broadcast list

#### Use case 2: Ask questions about a broadcast list or general topics

- RunHotTopicChat — Ask questions

#### Use case 3: Customize a broadcast list (channels, custom summaries, etc.) when the built-in broadcast list (hot topics) does not meet your needs

- SubmitCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob — Submit a custom broadcast list job

- GetCustomHotTopicBroadcastJob — Poll the status of a custom broadcast list job

- GetHotTopicBroadcast — Retrieve details of a custom broadcast list
